advice: Wear gloves while gardening or handling thorns, hay and soil. Treatment must be continued until all nodules heal.

name: Sporotrichosis

rx.instr: Continue 2–4 weeks after clinical cure; check LFT

rx.dose: 5 drops TDS, increase to 40–50 drops TDS
rx.instr: Alternative where itraconazole unaffordable; not in pregnancy/thyroid disease
